title: Node Anatomy
description: Node display content computed from semantic and visual data.
body: Node anatomy (PRD §12.6, §12.7, §12.8) — Wave 4. Every function here is pure and takes plain data, so it is what `frame.test.ts`-style tests exert directly and what `frame.ts` calls to fill in `DrawnNode`. Nothing in this file touches the DOM; `SchematicCanvas.tsx` only maps what is computed here onto markup. Every literal string quoted in PRD §12.7 and §12.8 is reproduced verbatim below, so a test can compare literally.
